newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Primedia buys four media firms.
newsitem.headline: Primedia buys four media firms.

text.p: South African integrated media group, Primedia Ltd, said on Wednesday it had bought four media businesses for a total amount of between 30 and 56 million rand depending on the achievement of certain profit targets.
Primedia said in a statement that the purchase prices will be settled through a combination of cash and Primedia "N" units.

The acquisitions of the firms, Cart-Ad, George Warman Publications, Intelligence Publishing and Marketel, are of a strategic nature and will not have a material effect on Primedia's earnings, it said.
Management will retain a stake in each of the businesses.
